summary: Standardized the shared Details, Notes, Audit Log, and tab-strip presentation across Dataset and method pages.
details: Dataset, DFM, Bornhuetter Ferguson, and Result Selection now use the same reusable tab surfaces while preserving their existing save and dirty-state behavior.
Details labels now use consistent punctuation and compact label-to-control spacing.

Dataset Viewer now lives under ui/dataset_viewer, DFM/BF/RS under ui/method_pages, and reusable tab, component, dataset-domain, integration, service, style, and utility modules under matching ui/shared sections.
